_meta.title: Custom car interiors: upholstery shops by town, Katzkin, materials and labour
_meta.purpose: Real-world basis for re-doing a car's interior to the player's own design (seats, door cards, headliner, carpets, steering wheel, stitching, piping) in a chosen material and colour, e.g. a leopard-print interior.

fieldKey.cityId: SLATE's city id, as in src/engine/content/carshops.ts. null on an entry that is a reference point outside SLATE's eight towns.
fieldKey.inTown: true when the shop is inside the town (or its city limits / Greater London / CDMX); false when it is a metro-area or national reference point, kept because it publishes a figure.
fieldKey.prices: Numbers in the local currency's major unit. 'from' is a published starting price; low/high a published range. vat says whether a UK/IE price includes VAT where the page says.
fieldKey.confidence: page-read = the figure or fact was read on the fetched page itself on the date given; search-summary = seen only in a search engine's summary or a directory listing, because the page could not be opened (403, expired certificate, truncated). Re-check search-summary figures before treating them as firm.

_meta.method: Shops' own sites first, then directories (Yelp, YellowPages, Golden Pages, yellowpages.ca) for addresses. Most auto upholstery shops in all eight towns publish no prices and quote only after seeing the car; where so, prices is empty and the note says so. Nothing was invented. Builds on research-gaps-cars-clothes.json (2026-10-02), research-customization.json (2026-09-30) and research-vehicle-shops.json (2026-10-01), whose upholstery figures are re-cited here where they were re-read.

options.colorsAndMaterials: Over 300 colours and materials: Katzkin premium leather (60 colours), Katzkin XT (thicker), Tuscany (soft), Barracuda (perforated duo-tone, 9 colours), Outlaw (tooled accents), AutoExotics (synthetic and embossed leather: simulated ostrich and crocodile, carbon fibre, machined metal), Suedezkin (synthetic suede, 10 accent colours).
options.stitchPlusPerf_TekFusion: 11 patterns, incl. Lightning, Diamond, Stairs, DuoHex, Vectronyx, Antlers, Bracelet
options.heatedSeats: Heat-only (high/low) or heat and cool (3 heat + 3 cool levels)
options.animalPrint: No leopard or other fur-pattern print found in the line. The exotic colour list read (Admiral, Aussie Black, Bahama, Bayou, Bermuda, Blush, Carbon Bullet, Carbon Crimson, Carbon Nickel, Carbon Shadow, Chrome, Electric Lime, Everglades, Lavender, Machined Silver, Screaming Green) has none; the animal patterns are embossed ostrich and crocodile. A leopard-print interior is therefore a custom-upholstery job, not a Katzkin kit.
options.scope: Katzkin kits cover seats (and often armrests/console lids); headliner, carpet and steering wheel are not part of a kit.

notes: Exotic colour list from https://www.autoseatskins.com/katzkin-exotic-colors-s/714.htm (a Katzkin reseller), read 2026-10-02.
Katzkin's NYC/Queens and LA location pages name no individual installer or price; the Queens page says the car 'should be done within a day'.
Vancouver's authorized installer is Pacific Restyling (1280 Clark Drive); Toronto installers include TM Custom Auto Trim (North York) and ColorGlo GTA (Vaughan). None publishes a price.
research-customization.json (2026-09-30) carries a secondary, unconfirmed 2-row $1,700-2,500 and heated seats ~+$400; not re-confirmed here.

notes: Coverage by town — New York: 5 shops (Best Yet, City Seat Covers, Ivan, McCoys, Mastercrafts in Lynbrook); the only NYC job prices are McCoys' $475 headliner / $375 seat, search-summary only. Los Angeles: 4 shops; only price is Best Way's headliner from $150, search-summary (site certificate expired). New Haven: 3 shops (HuDat West Haven, New Haven Auto Interiors and Hamden Auto Interiors, both Hamden), no prices. Toronto: 4 shops plus Katzkin installers in Whitby with page-read CAD prices. Vancouver: 4 shops, no prices. Mexico City: 4 shops; only prices are the headliner table from a low-confidence website. London: 3 shops in or near London (M Trim, J Cooper, Trim 'N' Stitch), none publishing prices; five UK shops elsewhere that do publish prices (Hide N Seat, Benema, Brothers, EDGE, Total Trim Solutions) are kept as UK reference points with cityId null. Dublin: 3 shops, prices only from classified ads and a Facebook page, search-summary.

The pattern holds in every town: custom auto upholsterers quote only after seeing the car. A per-town price for a full custom interior from a named in-town shop was not found anywhere; the best real figures are UK national price lists (Hide N Seat: complete interior from £2,000) and Katzkin's installed kit prices.

No shop anywhere publishes a lead time for a full custom interior. Lead times found: Katzkin kit 1-2 weeks, order-to-install 2-3 weeks, install 1-2 days; steering wheel by post 1 week (EDGE) to ~10 working days (Brothers); headliner 4-24 hours (CDMX site) or 1 day (Total Trim, Golf).

Leopard print: no shop in the eight towns advertises it by name, but all the custom shops (M Trim 'custom patterns', Trim 'N' Stitch, Toronto Auto Upholstery, Wraptors, Verst Cars and others) build covers from the customer's chosen material, so the realistic route is customer-chosen leopard vinyl or faux fur sewn by a trimmer. Katzkin does not offer a leopard print.
Faux fur: no automotive-rated faux fur was found; the faux fur listed is apparel/decor grade. Real seat use would need flame-retardancy (FMVSS 302 in the US/Canada) that these products do not claim.

Not found, and why: (1) Canadian per-yard retail prices for vinyl/Alcantara from a named Canadian supplier (Hydes Leather is trade-only; other results were US shops or Kijiji). (2) Irish material prices (Derek Nolan supplies fabrics but publishes no prices; UK suppliers such as Martrim are the nearest published source). (3) UK, Canadian, Mexican and Irish upholstery shop hourly rates: no published figure. (4) BLS 2024 data for upholsterers could not be fetched (bls.gov blocked the fetch); May 2023 used. New Haven has no upholsterers row in BLS's metro table. (5) A labour-time manual (Mitchell/ALLDATA) figure for seat reupholstery: not public; hours come from retailer guides.
Prices in GBP and EUR: VAT status is stated only where noted (Total Trim Solutions plus VAT; EDGE charges no VAT). Others do not say.

Figures already in earlier SLATE research and re-confirmed here: Katzkin from $2,195 (research-customization.json), Hide N Seat UK list (research-vehicle-shops.json), CDMX headliner table (research-gaps-cars-clothes.json).
